prompt_text: Best donor CRM with all features in one plan
response_text:
# Best All-in-One Donor CRMs (Single Plan with Full Features)

## **Top Recommendation: Kindful**
- **Price:** ~$100-150/month
- **Why:** All features included, no tiered pricing tricks
- **Includes:** Donation tracking, email marketing, reporting, online forms, integrations

## **Other Strong Options:**

### **Bloomerang** ($125-149/month)
- Complete feature set in base plan
- Excellent donor retention focus
- Email marketing included
- Strong reporting

### **DonorPerfect** (Custom pricing)
- Everything in one package
- Robust reporting
- Good for small-to-mid orgs
- May require quote

### **Little Green Light** ($59-99/month)
- Truly all features in every tier
- Just scales by contact volume
- Great value for smaller nonprofits

## **Budget Alternative:**

**Keela** (~$129/month)
- AI-powered insights
- All features standard
- Modern interface

## **What to Avoid:**
- Salesforce NPSP (requires expensive add-ons)
- Blackbaud products (notorious for nickel-and-diming)

**Pro tip:** Most CRMs offer 30-day trials. Test donation forms, reporting, and email tools before committing.

What's your organization's size and budget? I can narrow this down further.
